summary: These occur when an AI agent: - Executes a tool without sufficient authorization. - Performs an action the user didn't approve. - Performs the wrong action. - Executes an action multiple times. - Causes unintended changes in an external system. sections.title: Overview
sections.body:
These occur when an AI agent:

- Executes a tool without sufficient authorization.
- Performs an action the user didn't approve.
- Performs the wrong action.
- Executes an action multiple times.
- Causes unintended changes in an external system.

A side effect means an operation changes something outside the model itself.

Examples:

- Sending an email.
- Deleting a file.
- Booking a ticket.
- Transferring money.
- Updating a database.
- Creating a customer account.
